text: Opening meadow: the quiet forest landscape and morning atmosphere are introduced.
Big Buck Bunny wakes in his burrow, emerges, and stretches in the morning sun.
The rabbit explores the meadow, smells flowers, and befriends a butterfly.
Three rodents appear, harass the rabbit, and eventually capture the butterfly.
The rodents intensify their attack, pelting the rabbit and provoking his anger.
The rabbit prepares retaliation by constructing traps and weapons in the woods.
The rodents are lured through a fast-moving sequence of mechanical traps and pursuit.
The rabbit wins the confrontation, leaving one rodent flying like a kite.
Closing credits roll with final character animation and a return to the peaceful forest.
